items.title: Clyde Kerr Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: there was a book called Changes on the Chalkboard by Al Kennedy

ctx.x: Your father was credited somewhere they called him “the father of New Orleans big band?”

Yeah you can use some of that terminology. Yeah I would give him credit for doing that. Actually he was one of the people who started music education in the schools. Not only big band but he was one of the founders of — there was a book called Changes on the Chalkboard by Al Kennedy. Changes on the Chalkboard I think it’s Shawnee Press if you ever need a good book, and it deals with music education in the Orleans Parish school system. And my father was one of those who was very instrumental in getting it…
I’ll be darned, even in New Orleans, huh?
